copy.title: Core Builds Icon Pack
copy.short_description: 1023 icons and 132 wallpapers built for Android TV. No ads, no account.
copy.full_description:
An icon and wallpaper pack made for the television, not a phone app stretched onto one.

ICONS
1023 icons, mapped for the apps people actually run on a TV: streaming services, players, launchers, tools. Every app gets two shapes: a 16:9 banner, which this pack applies, and a square glyph, applied by the free Core Builds Glyphs Pack. The Art style switch moves between them, and the first time you pick square it takes you to the Glyphs Pack.

WALLPAPERS
132 stills across 11 series, from deep space to circuit boards, each with a matching thumbnail bundled in the app. The grid works offline; the full-size image downloads when you pick it, and saves to your own Pictures folder if you would rather set it yourself.

LIVE LOOPS
48 animated wallpapers, played by the system rather than a video app, so they keep moving while you browse.

HONEST ABOUT YOUR TV
The auditor lists which of your installed apps the pack covers, shows the exact icon file it would draw for any app, and can request a missing icon in one press. There is no account and no sign-in. Nothing is analysed in the background.

WORKS WITH
Launchers that accept icon packs, including Projectivy, FLauncher, AT4K, Leanback Launcher and Lawnchair variants. Where a launcher cannot be driven directly, the app says so and points you at the manual picker instead of pretending.

PRIVACY
No advertising, no analytics, no tracking, no account. Wallpapers are fetched from a public address; an icon request sends the app name, the component and a device note, and only when you press it.

data_safety.rationale: No analytics, advertising or crash SDKs are linked; the app has no account, no identifier and no background upload. The one POST the user can trigger (an icon request) carries the app name, the component and a device note - no device ID, no advertising ID, no IP-derived store beyond a rate-limit window on the broker - and the policy states it verbatim.

user_initiated_icon_request.trigger: the user presses Request icon on an auditor row

content_rating.note: A wallpaper and icon pack. Nothing here is user-generated, shared or interactive with strangers. 'online_content' is the full-size wallpapers and live loops, downloaded after install from this repo; none of it is rated content. 'purchases' follows the broker: Core Builds Plus is on sale exactly when the broker is baked in, and the answer stays yes while a track still serves such a build (BROKER_SHIPPED).
